input:
Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，一个男人觉得植物很有意思。他叫神农。有的植物吃了以后他的肚子疼死了，可是有的吃了以后很舒服。他找很多植物。

This scene:
凉山很大的山，这也找植物。一天，他找到黄色的花。他听说你跟黄色的花做茶很有用。比方说，你的头发疼死，这冰茶是药。他一喝茶就很不舒服。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. When the yellow flowers first appear, add visual detail: “黄色的花又大又漂亮，像星星一样。”
2. Show his physical reaction after drinking the tea: “他一喝茶，就捂着肚子，难受得不得了。”
3. Add an internal question to show his surprise: “他想：‘这杯茶不是很有用吗？我为什么这么难受？’”

ideas.reason: It adds a simple visual detail that fits his discovery of the yellow flowers.
The learner already says that he feels very uncomfortable as soon as he drinks the tea.
It adds a natural thought showing his surprise that the supposedly useful tea makes him feel ill.
